lead_raw_text:
The structure of La₂Ga₄Ni₄ (LaGa₂Ni₂) is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with a 10-atom unit cell and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Ga and Ni each have 12 geometric neighbors (La, Ga, and Ni), and La has 12 neighbors (Ga and Ni), with neighbor distances from about 2.62 to 3.11 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Ga–Ga and Ni–Ni 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Ga–Ni polyhedra sharing corners and edges.
